title: [PM seat] domain:ui · seat 2 — 🟢 os-steve · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责
body:
⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 2**, opened on the maintainer's word to add a seat to the lane (「你现在就可以增加席位啊」, project chat, 2026-10-26). Seat 1 is #25966. No `domain:ui` seat-2 post existed in the `pm:seat` index (open or closed) when this one was raised.

- **Current PM:** 🟢 `os-steve` · 由 os-steve 账户的项目负责 (Claude Code project "objectstack ui", seat thread "接管 ui 车道派发(席位 2)") · `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup` · seated 2026-10-26.
- **File area (split with seat 1; rebalanced on the maintainer's word 「你应该合理安排分工」, 2026-10-26):** seat 2 = `ui/packages/` plugin-list, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, fields, plugin-kanban, plugin-calendar, plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-timeline, plugin-tree, plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report; plus auth (`ui/packages/auth`, console / app-shell auth pages), the Setup / admin pages (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/**`), marketplace and the console sidebar. Seat 1 (#25966) = every other `domain:ui` path (i18n locales, `components` form, Studio / designer, chat / AI build, tech-debt). A card spanning both goes to the seat owning its main landing package. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#2`.
- **Priority (maintainer and coordinator, 2026-10-26T17:26Z):** priority comes first across the whole lane (p0 > p1 > p2 > p3). Package availability only breaks ties, and the seat split decides who takes a card, not when. A seat with free slots takes the other seat's unclaimed cards on loan (seat 1 holds #26182, #26183, #26275, #26276, #25872 and #25994 that way).
- **Hot-file serial queue** (refreshed 2026-10-26T20:23Z): read #25966's queue too. Across both seats, one card holds a file at a time.
  - Seat 2 holds:
    - `plugin-detail/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` and `renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts` (#25959, PR #26055)
    - `plugin-detail/DetailSection.tsx` and `HeaderHighlight.tsx` inline-edit pencils (#25883 item 1)
    - `fields/src/index.tsx` `DateCellRenderer` default and `plugin-grid/ObjectGrid.tsx` group-heading date default (#25884)
    - `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` and the Console runtime-config seam for `mapStyleUrl` (#26163)
    - `app-shell/.../metadata-admin/PermissionAdvancedFacets.tsx` (#26191) and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` position branch (#26187 PR 2); both add keys to `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`
    - `auth/src/RegisterForm.tsx` and console `RegisterPage.tsx` / `AuthFooter.tsx` (#25885, PR #26291 in the queue)
  - Waiting: #25895 (Related tab), after #26277 (seat 1) on `record-related-list.tsx`.
  - Decision box (`needs-user-decision`): #25934.
  - Parent `tracking`: #26059 (children #26187–#26195).
  - ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds for every ui card for now (maintainer's word in the project).
- **Landed today on seat 2's lines:** #26030, #26033, #26042, #26062, #26027, #26050 (#25937), #26212 (#26096), #26213 (#25891), #26231 (#26218), #26253 (#25933), #26269 (#26192), #26272 (#26238, the spec-count pin root fix), #26217 (#25942), #26273 (#26193), #26284 (#26187 PR 1).
- **Landing order** (since #26120, one sdui record per registry package): a PR enqueues only once every earlier PR that shares a registry package with it has MERGED. This order is agreed with seat 1.
  - plugin-detail: #26055 → #26277 (seat 1) → #25883 item 1
  - i18n: #26202 ✓ → #26055
  - plugin-grid / fields: #25884 → #25994 slices (seat 1)
  - A PR that moves `sdui.manifest.json` itself stays globally serial.
  - A PR outside the registry closure (app-shell, layout, apps/console, auth) or a test-only PR lands freely.
  - Patch round: merge main, take main's record, run `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` under the lock, commit the `sources/<pkg>.json` it moves, run `check-sdui-manifest`, then build Console.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer, project chat):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR is opened on the objectui repository; a change to a package inside the sdui registry closure (core, components, fields, i18n, react, types, the plugin-* packages …; not app-shell, layout or apps/console) re-records its `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/<pkg>.json` (and the artefact fields of `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`).
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#2` + `head:claude/` PRs.
- **Wall:** none.
